stance_rationale: The Forge package cannot be accepted because the claimed 268-month walk-forward schedule is a repeated 2026 stock profile, not PIT stock-level history. The package also omits DSR/Harvey 5-spec evidence and contains turnover/baseline defects that block AX-002 and AX-008 acceptance.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv has 268 dates but only 1 unique non-cash stock-weight profile; the same 18-stock 2026 production snapshot is repeated from 2004-02 through 2026-05. This is a single-snapshot backtest disguised as walk-forward.

alpha_scores.parquet is not Date x Ticker x score_*; it has 268 rows with Date, weight_str1715, weight_cash, note only. That blocks Iter-4-style time-series alpha verification and does not prove monthly alpha regeneration.

The repeated 2026 basket creates future-constituent exposure: 8 tickers are weighted before their first RAWDATA date, totaling 836 invalid weighted rows; early 2004 available exposure is only about 56.6% while holdings report full exposure.

Turnover reporting is not reliable: S0 shows 0 annualized turnover because weights never change, while overlay variants use contract annualization mean(turnover)*252 on monthly rebalance turnover, not a documented monthly round-trip x2 convention. Reported overlay turnover is 934%, 1648%, and 1242%, contradicting the <600% hard constraint.

Baseline fairness is unresolved: S0_baseline is not a same-period recomputation of the actual M4/STR_1715 walk-forward schedule, but the same repeated stock profile. The primary S0 MDD is 55.86%, breaching the 45% hard fail, and overlay variants miss the 20% CAGR floor.
Harvey/DSR evidence is absent: no CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, or FF6 t_NW/DSR outputs are present, and the 9 risk plus 5 optimizer candidates are not penalized consistently.

Artifact provenance is inconsistent: requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_007 is absent, monthly_returns.parquet is absent, and Forge audit records C15/lookahead self-scan WARN because factor_engine_path/lookahead_detector checks were skipped.

supporting_arguments: Package and weight md5 hashes match start/end, so RF-F1 is not the primary failure.
covariance.parquet is readable, symmetric, PSD, and condition number is about 48.19, passing the requested cond <= 100 check.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png exist and the lockbox-period line is visible.
weights.csv mechanically has 268 as_of_date values and sum weights near 1.0, but this is insufficient because the profile is static.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a repeated 2026 production basket can be called inherited STR_1715 walk-forward history.
Whether alpha_scores.parquet may be reduced to sleeve weights despite the base schema requiring Date x Ticker x score_*.
Whether recommendation_only status exempts DSR, Harvey 5-spec, MDD, and turnover hard gates.
Whether cash rows above 20% are exempt from name-level bounds in downstream hooks.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest assumption is that 268 dated rows prove walk-forward validity even though the underlying stock profile is one repeated 2026 snapshot.
rebuttal_required: Provide true PIT Date x Ticker x score_* alpha_scores.parquet for all rebalance dates.
Provide stock-level weights with materially changing monthly profiles derived from each sig_date, not repeated 2026 production weights.
Re-run backtest excluding tickers before first valid RAWDATA/listing date and report exposure gaps.
Fix turnover annualization and report total realized turnover after 15bps cost.
Provide same-period M4 baseline plus DSR and all 5 Harvey regressions.
rationalization_red_flags: structurally cannot fail standard optimizer red flags
cannot violate constraints it did NOT design

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge provides useful charts and hash evidence, but independent artifact checks find a PIT-breaking static stock schedule and missing statistical gate evidence. This fails the 2-source PASS requirement.
